title: FEATURE — /status show RapidAPI subscription lapse warning
rationale: RapidAPI subscription lapsed on 2026-03-26T00:09Z — pipeline cannot discover new viral content. /status shows no warning about this. data/rapidapi-lapse.json exists when lapsed. Add a check to cmdStatus() in cmd-system.ts to surface a visible warning when subscription is lapsed, so operator knows to renew. RAPIDAPI lapse = pipeline blind to new viral content.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-system.ts cmdStatus(): check if data/rapidapi-lapse.json exists and is within LAPSE_TTL_H=24h, add warning line to status output.
